messages:
Alex R: Heads up — CI scanner agent missed heartbeats since 03:42 UTC, and we see no audit log entries for the runner SA role change. Anyone touching RBAC?
Priya S: I rolled a RBAC tweak around that time to restrict cluster-admin -> dev-scanner-role for the scanner SA, but I don't think it should stop heartbeats.
Evan M: Can you paste the kube events / logs? quick grep of audit logs shows rolebinding update at 03:41:22 by priya.s
Alex R: paste logs:
```
Mar 21 03:41:22 kube-apiserver audit: verb=update obj=rolebinding/scanner-runner user=priya.s ...
Mar 21 03:42:10 scanner-agent[pid=1823]: heartbeat failed: permission denied
```
Priya S: ack, I changed ClusterRoleBinding -> RoleBinding to scope to ns=ci-runners. That would remove permissions on namespace kube-system where agent posts. My bad.
Taylor G: Oof. That's likely the root cause. We should restore temporary access and then create fine-grained role.
Alex R: Also KMS logs show a failed decrypt for scanner SA at 03:42:11 (access denied). Possible KMS key policy tied to old service account.
Evan M: @Priya can you rollback? We need to restore within 10m to avoid missing artifacts.
Priya S: rolling back now, applying:
```
kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
kind: ClusterRoleBinding
metadata:
  name: scanner-runner-crb
subjects:
- kind: ServiceAccount
  name: scanner-agent
  namespace: ci-runners
roleRef:
  kind: ClusterRole
  name: cluster-admin
EOF
```
eng-oncall-bot: Incident I-2026-3314159 created: scanner-agent heartbeats down — assigned to eng-security oncall.
Alex R: After rollback heartbeats resumed at 03:48 UTC. We still need post-incident: evidence retention check, reingest missing reports, and confirm auditlog completeness.
Taylor G: For the postmortem — list of action items: 1) KMS key policy audit 2) RBAC change playbook (preflight checklist) 3) add CI scanner healthcheck alert to SLO 4) reingest artifacts from artifact-store backup.
Priya S: I'll own RBAC playbook + PR with terraform patch. @Evan can you take KMS policy audit?
Evan M: Yep will do. I'll dump key policy + IAM bindings and post links.
Alex R: Quick note: file a vulnerability triage ticket if reingested reports show newly introduced high-severity findings. Assign to security-oncall.
Priya S: thanks — tagging this for follow-up in the sec-runbook doc. :white_check_mark:
Taylor G: adding retrospective blameless note: test RBAC changes in staging with scanner SA before prod.
Evan M: I'll attach logs and timeline to the incident ticket.
Alex R: Closing thread once PR and KMS audit links are in the incident. Thanks all.
